remarks: Beautifully remodeled 2-bedroom, 1-bathroom second-floor apartment in the heart of vibrant SoNo. This bright and updated unit features a newly remodeled kitchen with stainless steel appliances, a fully renovated bathroom, and new carpeting throughout. Enjoy off-street parking for two cars and the peace of mind of a meticulously maintained property with landlords living on-site.  Ideally located within walking distance to the train and the upscale SoNo Collection, and just minutes from the restaurants and retail shops along Connecticut Avenue.  (One garage bay may be available for a fee of $100/month)
